facts.text: The veteran field test engineer's objection is that tidy scripted scenarios omit the site itself.

facts.text: WorkSafe Western Australia's Significant Incident Report 226 describes an autonomous haul truck colliding with a manned water cart at night.

facts.text: In the autonomous haul truck collision described in Significant Incident Report 226, the turnaround loop had been released for use in the control system, but the corresponding intersection was not delineated on the ground.

facts.text: In the autonomous haul truck collision described in Significant Incident Report 226, the route was not communicated to other operators.

facts.text: The autonomous haul truck in Significant Incident Report 226 detected the water cart, but the truck's speed and response time were insufficient to prevent the collision.

facts.text: WorkSafe Western Australia named inadequate change management as a contributory cause of the autonomous haul truck collision with a manned water cart described in Significant Incident Report 226.

facts.text: The research dated the autonomous haul truck collision described in Significant Incident Report 226 to August 2015.
